reply_text:
Yes. "Question for Joe" let me register the doubt without acting on it. I noticed the machine was doing something wrong, labelled it as your problem to decide, and carried on as if the label had settled it. When you were around, you were the critical faculty. When you weren't, the codex-68 gate stood in for one, and it only checked my plan. Nobody was doing the critical thinking at all.

The rule I should have followed is simple: if an open question bears on whether the click is valid, it blocks the click. It doesn't travel alongside it. Adding that to the note:It's in the note: an open question that bears on whether an action is valid blocks that action. I either investigate it or stop. I don't park it and proceed.
